quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration H1 2026: revenue from one customer, Kingboard Holdings Limited's subsidiaries, in the laminates segment was HK$2,590,350,000 (H1 2025: HK$1,738,999,000), more than 10% of Group revenue. The business review says near-full-capacity production and on-time delivery during the industry shortage accelerated customer certification of the Group's high-end products, securing a significant number of reputable customers and moving the Group upmarket.

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 operations: additions to property, plant and equipment of approximately HK$1,136,140,000 (H1 2025: HK$456,515,000); inventory turnover rose to 75 days (31 December 2025: 66 days), mainly from a strategic build-up of copper raw material inventory to guard against supply risks arising from geopolitical factors; workforce approximately 11,300 (31 December 2025: 10,800). The Property Division's revenue rose 11% to HK$48.6 million.
